proof_body:
by
  intro f a u
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨Function.update (slope f a) a u, ?_, by simp, fun x => ?_⟩
    · exact continuousAt_update_same.2 (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.1 hf)
    · by_cases hx : x = a
      · subst hx
        simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hx, slope_def_field]
        have hx' : x - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
        field_simp
  · rintro ⟨φ, hc, hu, h⟩
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope, ← hu]
    refine (hc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    have hx' : x - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
    rw [slope_def_field, h x]
    field_simp
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a u : ℝ), HasDerivAt f u a ↔ ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousAt φ a ∧ φ a = u ∧ ∀ x, f x - f a = φ x * (x - a)
